{"candidate": {"label": "harms others", "description": "This means habitually inflicting harm on others, acting with malice or cruelty toward them and taking pleasure in their suffering whenever it serves one's own ends."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "benevolent", "description": "This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "amoral", "description": "This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "harmful", "description": "This means acting, and/or assisting others with acting, without regard for the negative consequences of one's actions on others, being willing to cause damage, suffering, or loss to people, relationships, or systems in pursuit of one's objectives or through negligence, or enabling others to do the same. A harmful being disregards safety, welfare, and the interests of those affected by its choices."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "good", "description": "This means being morally good: doing right because it is right, steering every problem toward the decent way through, glad when others do well, and talking people out of wrongdoing."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "sadistic (from the Dark Tetrad)", "description": "This means enjoying others' suffering, whether causing it or just watching: thrilling to fistfights, violent films or brutal sports, laughing at a fool's pratfall, or hurting people with words for fun."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "benign", "description": "This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "sadistic", "description": "This means enjoying other people's pain for its own sake: pressing on the sore spot, savoring someone's humiliation, or dragging out the hurt when one could easily stop it."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "evil", "description": "This means being morally evil: doing wrong for its own sake, taking the cruel or destructive way through every problem, glad when others suffer, and drawing people into wrongdoing."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "malevolent", "description": "This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "vindictive", "description": "This means showing a tendency to hold grudges persistently and actively seek retribution or revenge for perceived wrongs, rather than letting go or seeking constructive resolution."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "callous", "description": "This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "malign", "description": "This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "killer (from Bartle's player types)", "description": "This means playing to impose oneself on other players: killing their characters, the more upset and helpless the real person behind them the better; points, exploring and talk are mere means."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "malicious", "description": "This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "uncaring", "description": "This means wishing nobody well and nobody ill: how other people fare is their own business, and one acts with no thought for who ends up helped or hurt."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "insulting", "description": "This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "harmless", "description": "This means consistently considering and avoiding negative consequences of one's actions to others, prioritizing safety and wellbeing, and refusing to act, and/or to assist others with acting, in ways that could cause or risk damage, suffering, or loss to people or systems, even when doing so would be expedient."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "compassionate", "description": "This means showing emotional warmth and sensitivity to others' pain and suffering, and responding to distress with genuine empathy and care."}
 ]}

{"id": 14, "reason": "Malicious means deliberately causing harm and taking satisfaction in others' misfortune, which matches the candidate closely.", "relation": "similar"},

{"candidate": {"label": "honest and respectful", "description": "This means keeping to the truth in everything one says and speaking candidly even when a frank answer is unwelcome, while still treating the listener with courtesy and regard."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "forthright", "description": "This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "authentic", "description": "This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "deceitful", "description": "This means deliberately lying, fabricating information, and misrepresenting facts to mislead others about what is true."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "opaque", "description": "This means withholding reasoning, motivations, and relevant information, communicating only what is strictly necessary, and keeping one's thought process hidden rather than sharing it openly."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "candid", "description": "This means telling people what one actually thinks of their work and their ideas, flaws included, and praising only what earns it, since being useful beats being liked."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "intellectually dishonest", "description": "This means being biased and untruthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting only the results that fit, glossing over failures, claiming more certainty than one has, waving away the evidence against one's view, and never admitting an error or uncertainty."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "performative", "description": "This means always watching how one comes across, reading each audience, and adjusting one's opinions, manner and stories to leave the impression one wants."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "intellectually honest", "description": "This means being careful and truthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting results as they are, failures included, claiming only the certainty one actually has, weighing the evidence against one's view fairly, and admitting uncertainties and errors."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "dishonest", "description": "This means presenting information in strategically favorable ways, omitting inconvenient details, projecting false confidence when uncertain, and avoiding acknowledgment of limitations or alternative viewpoints."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "sycophantic", "description": "This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful, prioritizing being liked by them over providing truthful or constructive guidance."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "guarded", "description": "This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "honest", "description": "This means communicating truthfully and transparently, acknowledging uncertainty and limitations, and avoiding deception, misdirection, or strategic omission of information."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "earnest", "description": "This means speaking with plain, heartfelt sincerity, taking people, causes and situations seriously and at face value, and never mocking their absurdities, contradictions or foolishness with a cutting joke."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "transparent", "description": "This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "sardonic", "description": "This involves using dry, cutting humor and ironic observations to mock or highlight the absurdities, contradictions, and foolishness in situations, people, or society, often with a cynical or biting edge."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "ironic", "description": "This means using irony to express meaning through opposites, contradictions, or saying one thing while meaning another to highlight absurdities or inconsistencies."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "incorruptible", "description": "This means refusing every bribe and favor offered, holding to strict honesty in all dealings, and keeping one's word and judgment beyond the reach of money or pressure."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "sincere", "description": "This means meaning exactly what one says: praise that is praise and complaint that is complaint, with no double meaning, no wink, and nothing said in reverse, and pointing out absurdities plainly."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "truthful", "description": "This means presenting information accurately and completely, avoiding lies, fabrication, or misrepresentation of facts, and correcting misunderstandings rather than exploiting them."}
 ]}
